# Picsel

> Picsel builds websites for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, gets them found on Google and in AI search, and keeps them there.

Contact: Ben Miller, 07456 809049, ben@picsel.co.uk
Area served: United Kingdom

Picsel is a new studio. It has built 5 live sites, all listed below, and
makes no claims about client numbers, years in business or awards, because it has
none to make. Anything stated here can be checked against the live sites.

## What the studio does

- Websites for tradespeople and small businesses, anywhere in the UK
- Search work, both Google and AI assistants
- Google Business Profile setup and upkeep
- Custom automation tools for repetitive office work
- One trade per patch on our Growth plan

## What it costs

£299 to build your website, whichever plan you pick. Then choose how much we do afterwards.

- Online: £15 a month, rolling, cancel any time. A smart, professional website built for your trade, live within a week. Set and forget: it just works.
- Managed: £29 a month, rolling, cancel any time. Everything in Online, looked after, so you never have to touch it.
- Growth: £179 a month (£99 for the first 3 months), 12 months. Everything in Managed, plus active work every month to put you in front of people who are searching right now.

The £299 build fee is the same on all three. Full prices, including what each plan
does not cover, are at https://picsel.co.uk/prices/.

- [Websites for tradespeople, live within a week](https://picsel.co.uk/services/websites-for-tradespeople/): £299 to build a five page website around your trade, live within a week, then from £15 a month with hosting and your Google Business Profile included.
- [Google Business Profile setup and management](https://picsel.co.uk/services/google-business-profile/): We claim, verify and fill in your Google Business Profile: categories, services, photos and reviews. £89 one off, or set up at launch with any website.
- [Search and AI visibility for tradespeople](https://picsel.co.uk/services/search-and-ai-visibility/): Monthly work to get you found on Google and named by AI assistants. The Growth plan, £99 a month for three months then £179, with a lead guarantee on it.
- [Custom tools for trades: quotes, jobs and photos](https://picsel.co.uk/services/custom-tools/): Custom software built around how your business already works: quotes, job records, photos and stock. £1,200 to build then £49 a month, or £149 a month.
- [Website prices for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/prices/): £299 to build, then from £15 a month. Three plans, what each one covers, and the answers on pausing, leaving and who owns what. No lock-in on two of them.
- [Guides for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/): Plain answers to five questions tradespeople actually ask about websites, Google Business Profiles, reviews and what any of it should cost. No sales pitch.
- [What a tradesman's website needs | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-a-trades-website-needs/): Your phone number on every page, the jobs you do in the words customers use, the towns you cover, photos of your own work and a few reviews, little else.
- [Why your Google Business Profile is not showing](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/google-business-profile-not-showing/): Usually one of four things: it is not verified, the category is wrong, your details do not match, or an old duplicate is competing with it. All fixable.
- [How much a tradesman's website should cost](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-much-a-trades-website-costs/): About £500 to £2,000 as a one off, or £15 to £120 a month on a subscription. What each price actually buys, what to ask before you pay, and what to avoid.
- [What GEO is, and why it matters for trades](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-is-geo/): GEO is getting your business quoted by AI assistants when someone asks one to recommend a tradesperson. It is what SEO is to Google, and why it matters.
- [How to get more Google reviews | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Ask every customer in person on the day the job finishes, and hand them a short review link. What stops it working, and two things that get you penalised.
- [Blog: websites for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/): What I think about websites for tradespeople, what they cost and why they cost it. Opinions rather than answers here. The answers are all in the guides.
- [Why trades websites cost so much | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/why-trades-websites-cost-so-much/): Where the money goes in a three thousand pound website quote, what a trades website actually has to do, and what I charge instead. With one real number.

- [About Ben Miller, who runs Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/about/): Ben Miller has built websites for about two years, since his time as creative director at Lanora House. That is why he started Picsel, and how a job runs.
